title: gymnocarpium longulum
intro: Gymnocarpium longulum, commonly known as long beaked polypody, is a species of fern in the family Hymenophyllaceae. It is a non-vascular, epiphytic plant that grows on trees and rocks in moist, shaded areas. The long beaked polypody is valued for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health, due to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Gymnocarpium longulum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic properties.
